_help: Subtypes for custom cards (like Toon). Each name gets an archetype number that scripts use to check it: c:IsSetCard(SET_POKEMON). To add a new subtype, add a line here with the next number (0xf03, 0xf04...) and add the matching SET_ line in scripts/custom_utility.lua. Real card types (Gemini, Tuner, Toon, Spirit, Union, Flip) can also be written in Subtypes: and work automatically. (0xf0a is taken: it is the hidden "mentions Pokemon in its text" mark for Spells/Traps.)
